question: Can I accept a $150 gift basket from a vendor?
queries: Can I accept a $150 gift basket from a vendor?
gift value limit per year one source

results.title: Code of Conduct
results.heading: Accepting gifts
results.text: Employees may accept gifts from suppliers or clients worth up to $100 per year from any one source. Gifts above that value must be declined or reported to Compliance.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Limits
results.text: Client meals may cost up to $120 per person. A director must approve any client meal over $500 in total.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Working abroad
results.text: Employees may work from a country other than their country of employment for up to 30 days in a calendar year, with prior approval from HR.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Annual paid leave
results.text: Full-time employees earn 20 days of paid leave per calendar year, accrued at 1.67 days per month.

results.title: Code of Conduct
results.heading: Disclosure
results.text: Employees must disclose any outside job, board seat or investment in a supplier to Compliance within 30 days.
